Isaac Cohen  
📍 Bangalore, India | 📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 isaac.cohen@healthpulse.in | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/isaac-cohen-data | 🧠 github.com/isaac-cohen  

A results-oriented Senior Data Engineer with a 8-year track record in architecting scalable data ecosystems for healthtech platforms. Specializes in building end-to-end data pipelines, optimizing cloud infrastructure, and mentoring cross-functional teams. Known for delivering measurable ROI through automation, data governance, and real-time analytics. A MIT-trained data scientist with a proven ability to translate complex healthcare data into actionable insights.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Data Engineer*  
**HealthPulse Innovations** | Bangalore, India | 2022–Present  
- Spearheaded the design and implementation of a unified data warehouse on **Snowflake**, integrating disparate EHR and clinical data sources, resulting in a 40% reduction in data latency for predictive analytics models.  
- Architected **Apache Airflow** workflows to automate ETL pipelines, reducing manual intervention by 60% and improving data reliability across 5+ analytics teams.  
- Led the integration of **REST APIs** with third-party healthcare providers, enabling seamless data ingestion for 100,000+ patient records daily.  
- Optimized **Apache Spark** clusters for batch processing, achieving a 35% improvement in query performance while scaling to 10TB+ datasets.  
- Engineered **Terraform** blueprints for cloud infrastructure, reducing deployment cycles by 50% and ensuring compliance with HIPAA standards.  
- Mentored junior engineers in **Python**-driven data processing, resulting in a 25% increase in team productivity and code quality.  

*Lead Data Engineer*  
**VitalCare Systems** | Pune, India | 2020–2022  
- Designed and deployed a **data warehousing** solution on **Snowflake**, consolidating 15+ legacy systems into a single source of truth, enabling real-time dashboards for 10+ stakeholders.  
- Built a **Kafka**-powered streaming pipeline to process real-time patient vitals, achieving sub-second latency and reducing alert response times by 50%.  
- Developed **dbt** models for transformation and analytics, streamlining reporting workflows and reducing manual ETL efforts by 70%.  
- Spearheaded the migration of data processing logic from **Java**-based monoliths to **Go**-driven microservices, improving scalability and reducing maintenance overhead.  
- Collaborated with product teams to design **REST API** endpoints for data access, driving a 30% increase in internal tool adoption.  

*Data Engineer*  
**MedData Inc** | Hyderabad, India | 2018–2020  
- Built **Apache Spark** pipelines for batch processing of 500M+ health records, ensuring compliance with GDPR and HIPAA standards.  
- Implemented **ETL** workflows using **Python** and **SQL**, reducing data preparation time by 45% for analytics teams.  
- Contributed to the design of **Terraform**-based infrastructure as code, standardizing environments across 10+ development teams.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Data Warehousing**: Architectured **Snowflake**-based warehouses, optimized for healthcare analytics, with cross-team impact spanning 5+ departments.  
- **ETL Pipeline Design**: Engineered end-to-end pipelines using **Python**, **Apache Spark**, and **dbt**, with ownership of production systems for 3+ years.  
- **Python**: Core to data processing, mentoring teams on best practices and driving adoption of **dbt** for transformation logic.  
- **Apache Airflow**: Integrated into regular workflows for orchestration, automating 20+ pipelines across 50+ data sources.  
- **Apache Kafka**: Leveraged for real-time data streaming, ensuring low-latency processing for critical patient data.  
- **Apache Spark**: Optimized for large-scale batch processing, reducing query execution time by 35% in production.  
- **Go**: Used for building scalable microservices, replacing monolithic **Java** applications with modular architectures.  
- **REST API Design**: Developed APIs for data access, enabling seamless integration with external healthcare systems.  
- **Terraform**: Automated cloud infrastructure deployment, reducing manual configuration and ensuring compliance.  
- **dbt**: Central to analytics workflows, with production ownership of 10+ models driving 20% efficiency gains.
